description: This file defines FastAPI routes for MCP server interactions, including listing tools, calling MCP tools, and testing MCP server connections. It includes route handlers, helper functions, and conditional imports based on MCP availability.

classes.name: MCPServer
classes.description: Represents an MCP server configuration used for testing connections and listing tools.

methods.name: _get_server_auth_header
methods.description: Helper to retrieve server-specific auth header with case-insensitive matching.

methods.name: _create_tool_response_objects
methods.description: Creates response objects for MCP tools with server info.

methods.name: _get_tools_for_single_server
methods.description: Fetches tools from a single MCP server, applying allowed tools filter.

methods.name: list_tool_rest_api
methods.description: API endpoint to list available MCP tools, optionally for a specific server.

methods.name: call_tool_rest_api
methods.description: API endpoint to invoke a specific MCP tool with provided arguments.

methods.name: _execute_with_mcp_client
methods.description: Helper to create MCP client, execute an operation, and handle errors.

methods.name: test_connection
methods.description: Endpoint to test connectivity to an MCP server.

methods.name: test_tools_list
methods.description: Endpoint to preview tools from an MCP server before adding.
